positions.name: PallasineChecklistAsCurrentProcedure
positions.frame: what establishes the Pallasine checklist as the onboarding procedure now in force?
positions.why: Both expressions read the checklist not just as content (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) but as the currently governing artifact: src-1 states it as the universal rule every new hire follows, src-2 grounds its authority by naming what it superseded (the old wiki page, last quarter). Read together, the pair answers a single question — what makes this the operative procedure — rather than two separate facts; the conviction/relational reads (universal mandate, authority-ranking, agreed-procedure legitimacy) both point at this same directional concern with current governing status, not mere description.
